summary: H06G rejects hostile runtime inventories before filesystem or downstream effects and creates no staging artifact.
facts: Independent matrices rejected exact duplicate, unknown, reorder, absolute, parent traversal, parent-directory symlink alias, wrong type and empty inventories across Guardian, release_entries, Codex staging and Claude staging.
Path.resolve, lstat, readlink, Git, SHA-256, copy and prepare_output sentinels recorded zero touches before rejection; 16 of 16 guarded artifacts and 6 of 6 real artifacts were absent.
Real temporary Git and file attacks rejected unknown and both alias forms at all four production entry points without mocking the validator, digest, release or staging entry points.
